constraints: Preserve array and parameter helper behavior while moving from Zend\Stdlib to Laminas\Stdlib.
Keep composer.json, composer.lock, and any package that still requires zendframework/zend-stdlib consistent after the replacement.

steps.instructions: Remove zendframework/zend-stdlib from composer.json and require laminas/laminas-stdlib, then run `composer update`.
steps.title: Replace the dependency

steps.instructions: Replace reported Zend\Stdlib use statements, ArrayUtils calls, and Parameters constructors with the Laminas\Stdlib equivalents.
steps.title: Migrate Zend\Stdlib usages

verification.purpose: Confirm the Composer project is valid and laminas/laminas-stdlib is installed.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite with the replacement package.

sources.title: Endings and Beginnings: Goodbye, and Please Welcome the Laminas Project!

rule.summary: Packagist marks zendframework/zend-stdlib as abandoned and no longer maintained, and the author suggests using laminas/laminas-stdlib instead. The Laminas Project announced that Zend Framework packages were archived and marked abandoned on Packagist when the project moved to Laminas.
rule.title: zendframework/zend-stdlib is abandoned
